notes_for_editor: Thin record, two sources. The 1956 NGS description is the only dated evidence; the build date, builder, staffing and removal date are not in any source checked, so no removed event is recorded (events need a year). Brief coordinates (34.56843, -93.82214) do not match the ARGenWeb coordinates for its long-gone Gaston tower (34 deg 34'8.36" N, 93 deg 47'1.73" W, about 34.5690, -93.7838), a gap of roughly 3.5 km. Not verified, so no location correction is proposed. Not on the NHLR Arkansas list (checked 2026-10-21). Search results also show a Gaston tower in South Carolina off Highway 321; it is a different structure and was excluded. Access and visit status are not established by any source, so no access or visit facts are given.
